output:
### Summary

I reviewed commit 10d228d (`tests/run`, `tests/00-harness.sh`, `docs/spec.md`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`) against issue 30's four acceptance criteria. I read all four files in full and ran fixture experiments on a `/tmp` copy of HEAD and `origin/main`.

The `tests/run` half is sound. Keep and unset both behave as specified, the var is hidden from scenarios, and the harness test killed 9 of 10 mutants (the survivor is a redundant line, not a test gap).

The CI half does not work as written. `tests/22-dirty-tree.sh:123` leaves a file whose name contains a newline in its work dir, and `actions/upload-artifact@v4` rejects any path with that character and fails the whole upload. The artifact step would therefore error on nearly every red run. The branch is unpushed, so the workflow change has never executed and the passing gate log says nothing about it.

**Newly added dependency (one):** `actions/upload-artifact@v4`. It is a floating major tag, not a SHA. Today it resolves to v4.6.2 (`ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02`), declares `using: node20`, and depends on `@actions/artifact` 2.3.2. The latest release is v7.0.2 (2026-10-07). No other dependency was added.

### Findings

#### CRITICAL

None.

#### HIGH

- **Title:** The artifact upload fails on nearly every red run because of a newline-named file in the kept tree
- **Location:** `/home/alex/blast-off/.claude/worktrees/pending-items-53932d/.github/workflows/ci.yml:43-48`, combined with `tests/run:34` (keeps every scenario dir) and `tests/22-dirty-tree.sh:123`
- **Description:**
  - `22-dirty-tree.sh:123` runs `echo x > "$(dirname "$JOB")/notes"$'\n'".txt"`. The only `rm` in that file is line 62 (`zz.txt`), and `tests/lib.sh` `cleanup` removes no work-dir files. So the file is still there when `tests/run:34` moves the dir under `BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP`.
  - upload-artifact v4.6.2 `dist/upload/index.js:3356-3407` (`validateFilePath`) throws on any of `" : < > | * ? \r \n` in a file path. It is called per file at `:3684`, inside `getUploadZipSpecification`, which `uploadArtifact` runs before any backend call. The step fails and nothing is uploaded.
  - **Measured:** a fixture copying line 123, run through HEAD's `tests/run` with KEEP set, left `./22-dirty-tree/cwd/test-701289-newline/notes\n.txt`. A transcription of the validator over that tree gave `files checked=3 rejected=1` (Line feed).
  - **Scope:** every red run in which scenario 22 reaches line 123. `tests/run` continues after failures, so that is every case except 22 itself failing earlier or a pre-gate step failing.
  - **Not run:** the action itself, the real scenario 22, and any CI run. Running the downloaded v4 bundle offline was denied by the permission classifier; I did not retry it. The command, for the caller to run if wanted, was: `env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME=<tmp> INPUT_NAME=blast-off-tests INPUT_PATH=/tmp/bo-review.1mjuqk/keepA INPUT_IF-NO-FILES-FOUND=warn INPUT_COMPRESSION-LEVEL=6 INPUT_OVERWRITE=false INPUT_INCLUDE-HIDDEN-FILES=false node <downloaded v4 dist/upload/index.js>`.
- **Suggested fix:** Add a step under the same condition that tars the keep dir (`tar -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" -czf "$RUNNER_TEMP/blast-off-tests.tgz" blast-off-tests`) and upload the tarball. That is immune to any filename a scenario invents and also keeps `.git` dirs, modes and symlinks. Deleting the one file in scenario 22 fixes today's case only. Prove the step with one forced-red run before merge.

#### MEDIUM

- **Title:** A cancelled or timed-out job uploads nothing, and the in-flight scenario's dir is never under KEEP
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:14` (`timeout-minutes: 30`) and `:44` (`if: failure()`); `tests/run:27,34`
- **Description:**
  - GitHub's docs say the job timeout "automatically cancels" the job and `failure()` is true "when any previous step of a job fails" (workflow-syntax.md:1228, expressions.md:362). A cancel is not a step failure, so the upload is skipped. This is from the docs, not reproduced.
  - `tests/run` creates the work dir with `mktemp -d` and moves it only after the scenario ends, so a killed run leaves the current scenario's dir in `/tmp`.
  - Calibration: a single hang is handled. With `BLAST_OFF_TEST_TIMEOUT=1` a hung fixture came back `FAIL` and its dir was kept. The job timeout needs about six hung scenarios (3m50s normal run plus 6 x 300 s). A systemic CI-only fault, such as the user manager not coming up, is the case that reaches it.
- **Suggested fix:** Use `if: failure() || cancelled()`, or put a step-level `timeout-minutes` on the `tests/run` step so a timeout is a step failure.

- **Title:** The new action is pinned to a floating tag on a deprecated runtime, three majors behind
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:45`
- **Description:**
  - `actions/upload-artifact@v4` is a mutable tag (now v4.6.2) and its `action.yml` declares `using: node20`. The latest release is v7.0.2.
  - CI run 43778239611 on this repo already carries the annotation "Node.js 20 is deprecated ... forced to run on Node.js 24: actions/checkout@v4". The new step gets the same treatment.
  - The step only runs when the gate is red, so a runtime break would go unseen until the artifact is needed.
- **Suggested fix:** Use the current major, pinned to a SHA if the repo wants immutability. `actions/checkout@v4` has the same issue but is not part of this change.

#### LOW

- **Title:** An unwritable keep dir aborts the gate after scenario 1 with no `GATE:` line and leaks the work dir
- **Location:** `tests/run:18-19,34` and the header `Exit:` line at `tests/run:9`
- **Description:** The comment at line 18 covers only a dir that cannot be made (reproduced: `mkdir` error, exit 1, no scenario run). With an existing `chmod 555` KEEP, the run printed `PASS 01-a`, then `mv: cannot move ... Permission denied`, exit 1, no verdict line, scenario 2 not run, and `tmp.rJj6yTlui4` left behind. The header says exit 1 means `GATE: FAIL ...`.
- **Suggested fix:** Probe writability up front (`[ -w "$KEEP" ]`), or accept it and correct the comment.

- **Title:** A keep dir under the repo's `bin/`, `lib/` or `tests/` turns the gate red through shellcheck
- **Location:** `tests/run:7-8` (header) and `tests/run:42`
- **Description:** The shellcheck glob `"$REPO"/tests/**` lints kept fixture scripts. Reproduced on a mini repo: `BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP=tests/kept tests/run` gave `SC2034 ... GATE: FAIL passed=1 failed=1 shellcheck=fail`; the same run with KEEP outside the repo passed. In the real suite `00-harness` leaves `self/tests/fakes/claude` (`x=1`), which triggers the same warning. A repo-root keep dir is also untracked, since `.gitignore` holds only `.big-next-job/` and `.worktrees/`.
- **Suggested fix:** Add one phrase to the header: keep dir outside the repo.

- **Title:** The keep dir is never emptied, so dirs from scenarios not in this run persist
- **Location:** `tests/run:34`
- **Description:** Reproduced: a run with `01-a`, `02-b`, then a run with only `01-a` into the same KEEP, left `01-a 02-b`. Two concurrent runs sharing one KEEP would also clobber each other. Not an issue in CI, where `runner.temp` is fresh.
- **Suggested fix:** Say so in the header; no code needed.

- **Title:** Absolutising KEEP does nothing
- **Location:** `tests/run:19` (`KEEP="$(cd "$KEEP" && pwd)"`)
- **Description:** The main shell never changes directory (the `cd` at line 28 is in a subshell). The mutant with this removed passes `00-harness`, including its relative `kept` case.
- **Suggested fix:** Reduce to `mkdir -p "$KEEP"`.

- **Title:** Hidden files are dropped from the artifact, contrary to the workflow comment
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:36,45-48`
- **Description:** v4 defaults `include-hidden-files: false` (action.yml; README line 67). Scenario repos' `.git` dirs and any dotfiles are excluded, so the artifact is not "every scenario's work dir". The file's top comment (lines 1-4) also does not mention the artifact.
- **Suggested fix:** The tar fix above resolves it; otherwise correct the comment.

- **Title:** Fixed artifact name with `overwrite` left at false (unverified)
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:47`
- **Description:** v4 fails "if an artifact for the given name already exists". I could not establish whether a "Re-run failed jobs" attempt counts as the same run for this check.
- **Suggested fix:** `name: blast-off-tests-${{ github.run_attempt }}`.

- **Title:** No `retention-days`
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:46-48`
- **Description:** Debug artifacts keep the repo default (up to 90 days).
- **Suggested fix:** `retention-days: 7` or similar.

- **Title:** The upload step also fires when a pre-gate step fails
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:44`
- **Description:** If dependencies or the systemd step fail, the keep dir does not exist and the step emits a "no files found" warning (`if-no-files-found: warn`). Noise only.
- **Suggested fix:** None needed, or `if-no-files-found: ignore`.

- **Title:** The unset half of the test asserts only the exit code
- **Location:** `tests/00-harness.sh:36-37`
- **Description:** Line 36 checks that the run exits non-zero, then that `tmp` is empty. It does not check `keepfix.out` for the verdict, so "removed" is proven only on the assumption that both scenarios ran with `TMPDIR` honoured. The single mutant "no rm when unset" is killed, so this is a tightening, not a hole.
- **Suggested fix:** Repeat the line 29 verdict `grep` after line 36.

- **Title:** The commit carries three baton-runner bookkeeping files beyond the four reviewed
- **Location:** `baton-runner/br-1115-issues/STATE.md`, `baton-phase-1-work.md`, `log.md` (104 lines)
- **Description:** `origin/main` tracks 0 files under `baton-runner/`; this commit introduces the directory. Outside my materials; I did not review their content.
- **Suggested fix:** Decide whether runner bookkeeping belongs in this repo's history.

### Validated

**Confirmed correct**

- **Criterion 1, keep:** a fixture run with KEEP left `<keep>/<name>/out` and `<keep>/<name>/cwd/...` per scenario, passed and failed alike. A timed-out scenario is kept too (`keep7/01-hang/out` = `started`).
- **Criterion 1, unset:** HEAD and `origin/main` gave identical output and exit code on three fixtures (`fx2`, `fx3`, `fxA`) with `TMPDIR` pinned. An empty `BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP=` behaves as unset (0 entries left in TMPDIR).
- **Hidden from scenarios:** `00-harness` alone with an outer KEEP left only `00-harness` in the outer dir. With the `unset` removed, the outer dir also held `01-ok` and `02-bad`.
- **Criterion 4, mutation probes on `tests/run` (9 killed, 1 survived):**
  - Killed: drop the `unset`; always `rm`; keep only failed; keep only passed; no `rm` of the earlier kept dir; `cp -r` instead of `mv`; no `rm` when unset; drop `cwd`; empty the kept `out`.
  - Survived: no absolutising of KEEP (the redundant line above).
- **`set -e` inside the `|| { ...; }` group at `tests/run:19`:** `bash -c 'set -e; [ -z "x" ] || { false; echo after; }; echo end'` exits 1 with no output, so a failed `mkdir` does abort.
- **Not a regression:** a scenario leaving a `chmod 555` dir aborts `origin/main`'s `tests/run` the same way (`rm: cannot remove ... Permission denied`, exit 1).
- **Criterion 2, syntax and contexts:** the YAML parses to the expected five steps. `runner` is an allowed context in `steps.env` and `steps.with`, and `failure` in `steps.if` (github/docs `contexts.md:109,110,114`). The upload needs no permission beyond `contents: read`.
- **Criterion 3:** the header documents the var at `tests/run:7-8`; `docs/spec.md:215` names the behaviour in the `00-harness` row, and its wording matches what I measured.
- **Full gate at this commit:** `baton-runner/br-1115-issues/gate-phase-1-iter-1/tests-run.log` ends `GATE: PASS passed=18 failed=0 shellcheck=ok` (33 files).
- **Symlinks:** scenarios 23 and 61 leave symlinks to files; the action's glob follows them (`dist/upload/index.js:125432`).
- **Secrets:** no scenario or fake dumps the environment (grep for `printenv`, `export -p`, `env >` found nothing); `GH_TOKEN` in scenarios is `dummy-not-a-token`.
- **Other rejected filenames:** a grep of literal names in `tests/*.sh`, `tests/fakes/*`, `lib/*.sh` and `bin/blast-off` found only the one at `22-dirty-tree.sh:123`.

**Examined, inconclusive**

- **The upload step end to end** (`ci.yml:43-48`): needs a red CI run. The branch is not on the remote and `gh run list --branch` returned nothing.
- **`failure()` under a job-timeout cancel** (`ci.yml:14,44`): docs read, no run.
- **Artifact name collision on a re-run attempt** (`ci.yml:47`): the README and `action.yml` do not settle it.
- **upload-artifact v4.6.2 on forced Node 24:** only `checkout@v4` is observed running that way.

**Not examined**

- A kept tree from a real full-suite run; my filename inventory is static.
- Cross-device `mv` (KEEP on a different filesystem from `mktemp`'s). I did not test outside `/tmp`, and did not verify that `RUNNER_TEMP` and `/tmp` share a filesystem on `ubuntu-24.04`.
- The three `baton-runner/` files in the commit.
- The rest of `docs/spec.md` against the code; I read it in full but checked only the changed row.

Experiment dirs are left at `/tmp/bo-review.1mjuqk` (6.8 MB), with downloads in the session scratchpad; nothing in the worktree was touched.

### Confidence

High for the `tests/run` and test findings (all measured); medium-high for the HIGH finding, which rests on the action's read source plus a fixture rather than a real upload. One forced-red CI run would settle it and the three inconclusive CI items.
